note: Each wasm build profile's gzipped size, held by `cargo xtask footprint
--profile NAME --gzipped BYTES`. The workflow builds the profile as
release.yml's npm job builds the wasm, counts `gzip -9 -c ... | wc -c`
and passes the number in. A size over `figure.bytes` plus
`tolerance.bytes` fails; a shrink passes and prints the `--record` line
that writes it as the figure, with its run and day, keeping the
tolerance. A profile with no entry fails unless the job names it
`figure` is one run's measurement: `bytes`, the `date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and
the `run` id. `tolerance` is measured, never assumed: `bytes` is the
widest spread of one revision's size over the workflow `runs` it names
and the `toolchains` they built with, and zero is a measurement too.
